one_line_description.value: Freshdesk is a cloud-based customer support platform that lets companies of all sizes talk to their customers and manage support conversations.
one_line_description.quote: Freshdesk is a cloud-based customer support platform that was founded with the mission of enabling companies of all sizes to provide great customer service.

has_public_api.quote: All the endpoints you need to access and manage your data, and bridge your helpdesk with the other tools you use.

api_type.quote: Freshdesk's APIs belong to the Representational State Transfer (REST) category.

api_breadth.value: REST v2, JSON, read-write; multiple resource categories including tickets, contacts, Business Hours, Products, Email Configs, and SLAs
api_breadth.quote: Four new API categories - Business Hours, Products, Email Configs, and SLAs 4.

docs_url.quote: Version 2 of the API brings several new features as well as changes to the previous APIs.

auth_methods.quote: Freshworks MCP for Freshdesk currently supports API key authentication only.

access_model.quote: For all trial users, there is a default API limit of 50 calls/minute.

access_notes.value: A self-serve Freshdesk account/trial provides API credentials; trial accounts are capped at 50 API calls/minute and production rate limits are plan-tiered. Sandbox is listed only on the Enterprise plan ($89/agent/month) and the MCP integration is restricted to Growth, Pro and Enterprise plans.
access_notes.quote: For all trial users, there is a default API limit of 50 calls/minute.

official_mcp_server.quote: Ensure to use your Freshdesk base domain in the following format: https://.freshdesk.com/mcp

rate_limits.value: Trial 50 calls/minute; Growth 100/minute, Pro 400/minute, Enterprise 700/minute; per-endpoint sub-limits apply (e.g., Growth: Ticket Create 50, Ticket Update 50, Tickets List 40, Contacts List 40); older plans are hourly (Blossom/Garden 3,000/hr, Estate/Forest 5,000/hr)
rate_limits.quote: | Growth | 100 | Ticket Create - 50 Ticket Update - 50 Tickets List - 40 Contacts List - 40 |

api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.value: Versioned API (v2 is current, surfaced via the X-Freshdesk-Api-Version header, e.g. latest=v2; requested=v2); v2 introduced new deprecation and breaking-change policies, and XML support is deprecated in favor of JSON only.
api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.quote: XML Support has been deprecated, only JSON is supported

verdict_reason: Freshdesk publishes a public REST v2 API reference covering tickets, contacts, Business Hours, Products, Email Configs and SLAs with read/write JSON operations. A self-serve account/trial gets API-key access with a documented 50 calls/minute default limit, and production rate limits are plan-tiered (Growth 100/min, Pro 400/min, Enterprise 700/min). No partner approval, app review or sales contact is required to start building.
open_questions: Core REST API authentication options beyond the API key (OAuth 2.0, OAuth scopes, basic auth) were not captured in the fetched pages; only MCP API-key authentication was explicitly quoted.
No webhook/event-callback documentation was present in the evidence bundle (support articles appeared in search results but were not fetched), so webhooks is marked not_found rather than false.
No official SDK language list was found in the fetched sources; the mobile SDK support article was in search results but not in the bundle.
A search snippet suggests the API key and API functionality are unavailable on the entry-level Sprout plan, but that support page was not in the bundle and could not be quoted.
No community/third-party MCP servers were found (GitHub and MCP registry checks returned nothing).
The official MCP server endpoint is per-tenant (https://<domain>.freshdesk.com/mcp) and custom domains are not supported; MCP is limited to Growth, Pro and Enterprise plans.
